title: Sunday Thai Chicken Curry
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Thai-inspired dish perfect for lazy Sundays. This chicken curry combines the flavors of coconut milk, lemongrass, and chilies for a tasty and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the lemongrass, chili peppers, fish sauce, and brown sugar. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10-15 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the basil and serve hot.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles.
